review_method: Evidence-constrained desk reconciliation of original concept-note entries and acquired OSM feature identities; not custodian approval or independent positional validation.

decisions.decision: No unambiguous market object returned. Hostel and taxi facility rejected. Published coarse Al Arabi reference coordinate is not adopted as a validated market point.
Named retail-area polygon way/108706657 is a candidate, not independently established market footprint. Viewpoint, apartment and greengrocer points rejected as market coordinates.
Named neighbourhood polygon way/178258112 retained as candidate context only. Neighbourhood centre and supermarket point do not validate the market location.

Exact distinctive market name and marketplace tag; actual OSM node coordinates checked against source API. Source-verified inventory point only, not a surveyed position, market entrance or current operation finding.
No result for the literal source spelling. Intended market remains unresolved; no spelling correction or substitute site adopted.
Same-name node/4548460093 exists but is tagged shop=department_store. It is not accepted as the concept-note market without corroboration of site and role.
No result from either documented livestock or camel lookup. Combined livestock/camel paragraph remains one source entry; distinct-site count and both locations unresolved.
Restaurants and differently named markets rejected. Dabanga supports El Morada neighbourhood market identity historically, not an exact fish-market point or footprint.

Arabic market name and English alias agree with concept entry; actual marketplace node coordinates checked against source API. Dabanga corroborates the market in western Omdurman, not the precise point. Not an entrance or current-status finding.
Returned post office, shops and educational institutions rejected. Malformed original name retained; no substitution of Saad Gishra or another Bahri market.
Same-name node/4617489993 is tagged tourism=hotel and rejected as a market coordinate. Keep separate from Khartoum central-market entry.
No market result for the documented lookup. Settlement positions are not market positions. Concept Bahri versus supplied assessment Sharg El Neel discrepancy unresolved.

Named marketplace polygon agrees with supplied assessment market alias; source OSM way/nodes checked against returned geometry. Retain polygon, not Nominatim centre. Locality derived only if entire polygon is contained in one adopted COD locality.
No result for the documented query. Nonunique numbered market and Bahri/Sharg El Neel discrepancy unresolved. East/west sections are not silently split into separate markets.
